dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular light-toned annular structures with soft-edged gradients transitioning from dark-gray exterior backgrounds to light-gray perimeters, predominantly located on the mid and posterior dorsal regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of discrete, small, light-gray pixel clusters concentrated on the head and along the upper dorsal line, characterized by uniform intensity without internal gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary configuration of three prominent annular rings on the mid-posterior flank forming an obtuse scalene triangle; secondary light blobs on the cranial region form a roughly linear spatial arrangement.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced light-gray ocular and sub-orbital markings creating a high-contrast spectacle pattern relative to the dark facial pigment.
